title: Railroad swap to complete light blue
description: Railroad swap to complete light blue. A railroad swap plus small cash completes a cheap set without creating opponent monopoly. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd like to buy your B&O Railroad for $200 cash. Let me know if you're interested!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring a second railroad boosts rent potential and moves me toward a railroad monopoly. Beta has plenty of cash, so $200 is a fair offer.
